editions.description: Ordered list of up to 5 featured edition targets.

createdAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix, when this record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Optional canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix, when this record was last updated.

main.description: A singleton, actor-curated list of editions featured on the actor's reader profile.
